name: Treasury Fiscal Data API
agency: U.S. Department of the Treasury (Bureau of the Fiscal Service)

endpoints.description: Average interest rates on US Treasury securities

limits.notes: No key and no published hard quota. Default page size 100, max page[size]=10000. Be polite on bulk pulls.

llmDocs.summary: Federal financial data: national debt, daily Treasury statement, interest rates on Treasury securities, exchange rates, spending/revenue. No key required.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Each dataset is its own endpoint path. Use fields=, filter= (e.g. record_date:gte:2025-01-01), sort=-record_date, and page[size]=. Discover datasets and field names from the API documentation site.
gotchas: Filter syntax is field:operator:value (eq, gte, lte, in, etc.) — not standard query params.
Default page size is 100; large datasets need pagination via page[number].
Each dataset has different field names and date columns; consult the dataset's metadata.

compliance.redistributionNotes: Public domain US government data, free to use and redistribute.
